supersedes.reason: Contract lunum-agent/0.4 adds the placeholder_role abstention rule (decisions/0007); task profile iteration 3 closes unit and term-type gaps found in the 2026-09-26 live run. V8 is in-sample for these changes.

freeze.sourceBinding: The commit that added this file (git log --diff-filter=A -- <this file>). The artifact hashes below are the binding.

conventions.kind: Use the task-declared kind only when source evidence supports it; parcel/document/object distinctions are typed semantic choices, not aliases.
conditional: repeat explicitly stated modality on coordinated actions
roles: send(agent, object, recipient); recipient is not destination
retry preserves count and date when stated
conventions.modality: Obligation and permission are distinct; lexical negation uses negated and is never rewritten as an antonym.
conventions.quantityAndTime: Preserve finite numeric value and ISO date at clause time; normalize units per the task profile (% -> percent).
conventions.identity: Exact identity only for source-visible stable names, identifiers, literals, dates, and task-typed roles; never infer private handles.
conventions.abstention: Explicitly abstain for unsupported, ambiguous, or unresolved meaning, and when the source does not state a role the frame requires; never fill a role with its type name or the verb. Retain source and provenance.

delivery.preflight: Call lunum_get_extraction_contract through the built stdio MCP server and require the returned contractVersion, instructionHash, schemaHash, and frameRegistryHash to match freeze; compute sha256(stableStringify(contract)) with @corpunum/lunum canonicalization and require it to match freeze.coreContractHash. JSON.stringify bytes are a separate serialization hash.
